mainTopic: Does a permitted food join with a forbidden food to reach the minimum amount (היתר מצטרף לאיסור)? First, זעירי applies it to burning leaven on the מזבח. Then אביי challenges רב דימי's report of רבי יוחנן's rule.
overview: זעירי teaches that the rule 'permitted food joins with forbidden food to make up the amount' also applies to the ban on offering leaven (שאור) on the מזבח. The גמרא says he follows רבי אלעזר, who learns from the word 'כל' that mixtures count. It asks why זעירי did not also mention eating חמץ on פסח. The answer is that the rule applies there too. זעירי's real point is to reject אביי and teach that offering less than a כזית is not punishable. Then רב דימי repeats רבי יוחנן's teaching that permitted joins with forbidden only for a נזיר. אביי objects from a משנה about a soup with תרומה garlic and oil that a טבול יום touched. רבי יוחנן himself explained that a זר is lashed for eating a כזית of that soup, even though most of it is חולין. אביי asks for the reason behind this, building a contradiction that the גמרא takes up on the next amud.

steps.title: זעירי: the joining rule also applies to offering leaven
steps.stepSummary: זעירי rules that permitted and forbidden foods join together for the ban on offering leaven on the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: זעירי said: leaven also follows this rule, for the prohibition of 'you shall not burn it on the altar.'
steps.whatsHappening: זעירי adds a new case to the rule that permitted food can join forbidden food to make up the full amount: offering leaven on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rule we have been discussing is היתר מצטרף לאיסור. Normally it is limited, but זעירי says it also applies to the לאו of בל תקטירו (offering leaven). So a mixture that is only partly leaven can still bring liability.

keyTerms.meaning: Leaven, sourdough starter
The prohibition 'you shall not burn' leaven or honey on the מזבח
An אמורא, the author of this statement

phrases.english: Ze'eiri said:
Also leaven, regarding 'you shall not burn it on the altar.'
phrases.notes: The פסוק is ויקרא 2:11. He means the permitted part joins with the leaven here too.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: היתר מצטרף לאיסור applies to the prohibition of offering leaven on the מזבח.

steps.title: Whose opinion does זעירי follow?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which earlier authority זעירי's ruling matches.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא sets up the next move by asking which תנא זעירי is following.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A new rule needs a source. The גמרא wants to anchor זעירי's ruling in an existing opinion.

keyTerms.meaning: In accordance with whom?

phrases.english: In accordance with whom?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of זעירי's ruling.

steps.title: He follows רבי אלעזר, who learns from 'כל'
steps.stepSummary: זעירי follows רבי אלעזר, who learns from the word 'כל' that mixtures count.
steps.simpleTranslation: Like רבי אלעזר, who derives a lesson from the word 'all'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that זעירי follows רבי אלעזר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אלעזר reads the word 'כל' (all) as including mixtures. The leaven פסוק also uses 'כל', so the same reading lets a mixture count for offering leaven.

keyTerms.meaning: Expounds, learns a law from a word in the פסוק
'All'; read as including mixtures

phrases.english: Like Rabbi Elazar,
who expounds the word 'all'?
phrases.notes: This is the word 'כל' in the חמץ פסוק, שמות 12:20.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: זעירי follows רבי אלעזר's reading of 'כל'.

steps.title: Then the same should apply to eating חמץ
steps.stepSummary: If זעירי follows רבי אלעזר's 'כל', the joining rule should also apply to eating חמץ on פסח.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, it should also apply to the matter of חמץ!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges זעירי: why mention only offering leaven, when רבי אלעזר's reading would also cover eating חמץ?
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אלעזר's 'כל' comes from the חמץ פסוק itself. So the joining rule should apply to חמץ even more clearly. זעירי's choice to name only offering leaven seems strange.

keyTerms.meaning: If so
Leavened food, forbidden on פסח

phrases.english: If so,
then regarding leavened food also!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Pushes the source from step 3 to a further case.
steps.kashyaTarget: זעירי's limiting the ruling to offering leaven
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי אלעזר's source applies to eating חמץ as well, so why did זעירי speak only about offering leaven?

steps.title: Yes, and זעירי's point is no liability below a כזית
steps.stepSummary: The rule does apply to חמץ too. זעירי mentioned offering leaven to reject אביי's view that offering less than a כזית is punishable.
steps.simpleTranslation: Yes, that is indeed so. But זעירי's purpose was to exclude the view of אביי, who says that offering less than a כזית counts. זעירי teaches us that offering less than a כזית does not count.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא agrees that the rule applies to חמץ. It explains that זעירי spoke about offering leaven to make a different point: there is no punishable offering of less than a כזית.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If offering any amount were already punishable, as אביי says, there would be no need for permitted food to join and fill out the amount. By saying the joining matters, זעירי shows that a full כזית is needed. So offering less than a כזית is not punished with lashes.

keyTerms.meaning: Yes, that is indeed so
To exclude, to reject another view
Burning an offering on the מזבח
An olive's size, the standard minimum amount
He teaches us

steps.whatToRemember: זעירי agrees the joining rule applies to חמץ. He mentioned offering leaven only to teach that offering less than a כזית is not punishable, against אביי.

phrases.english: Yes, that is indeed so.
But he means to exclude the view of Abaye,
who says: offering less than an olive's size counts,
he teaches us:
offering less than an olive's size does not count.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִין הָכִי נָמֵי אֶלָּא לְאַפּוֹקֵי מֵאַבָּיֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 4 by accepting it and changing the purpose of זעירי's statement.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Concedes the point and explains the hidden purpose of the statement
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Without זעירי, one might follow אביי that offering any amount, even less than a כזית, is punishable.
steps.terutzMaskana: Offering leaven requires a full כזית, which the permitted food can help complete. Less than a כזית is not punishable.

steps.title: אביי challenges רב דימי from the soup משנה
steps.stepSummary: רב דימי teaches רבי יוחנן's rule that permitted joins with forbidden only for a נזיר. אביי objects with a משנה about soup touched by a טבול יום.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב דימי sat and said this teaching. אביי objected to him: If a thick soup was of תרומה and the garlic and oil were חולין, and a טבול יום touched part of them, he disqualified all of it. If the thick soup was of חולין and the garlic and oil were of תרומה, and a טבול יום touched part of them, he disqualified only the place he touched.
steps.whatsHappening: This opens a new discussion. רב דימי repeats רבי יוחנן's teaching, and אביי sets up an objection by quoting a משנה about mixed soup.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first case the main food is תרומה, so the whole pot counts as תרומה. In the second case only the garlic and oil are תרומה, yet the spot that was touched still becomes disqualified. אביי is preparing to ask why that spot is disqualified at all. That question comes in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: A teaching or ruling
He raised an objection against him from an earlier source
A thick soup or stew
The holy portion of produce given to a כהן
Ordinary, non-holy food
Someone who immersed today and is pure only after nightfall; he disqualifies תרומה he touches

phrases.english: Rav Dimi sat
and was saying this teaching.
phrases.notes: This is רבי יוחנן's teaching: permitted food joins with forbidden food only for a נזיר.

phrases.english: Abaye raised an objection to him:
If the thick soup is of terumah,
and the garlic and the oil are non-sacred,
and one who immersed that day touched part of them,
he has disqualified all of them.
If the thick soup is non-sacred,
and the garlic and the oil are of terumah,
and one who immersed that day touched part of them,
he has disqualified only the place he touched.

steps.triggerLanguage: יָתֵיב רַב דִּימִי וְקָאָמַר לַהּ לְהָא שְׁמַעְתָּא אֵיתִיבֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new discussion about רבי יוחנן's rule, as reported by רב דימי.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's rule, reported by רב דימי, that permitted joins with forbidden only for a נזיר
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה treats a mostly-חולין soup as disqualified where it was touched. רבי יוחנן's explanation of this (step 7) shows that the small amount of תרומה counts together with the חולין, outside of נזיר.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן's own reason: a זר is lashed for a כזית
steps.stepSummary: אביי recalls the discussion of that משנה. רבי יוחנן explained that the touched spot is disqualified because a זר is lashed for eating a כזית of the soup.
steps.simpleTranslation: And we discussed it: why is the place he touched disqualified? And רבה בר בר חנה said in the name of רבי יוחנן: what is the reason? Because a non-כהן is lashed for eating a כזית of it.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי sharpens his objection. רבי יוחנן himself gave a reason for the משנה that seems to use permitted food joining with forbidden food.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The soup is mostly חולין, so the touched spot should not have become disqualified. רבי יוחנן explains that the whole mixture counts as תרומה, so a זר who eats a כזית of it gets lashes. In a כזית of soup the תרומה is only a small part, so the חולין seems to be joining it to make up the כזית. That is outside of נזיר, which goes against רב דימי's report.

keyTerms.meaning: And we discussed it, we found it difficult
The place he touched
A non-כהן, who may not eat תרומה
Receives lashes

steps.confusionAlert: Here רבי יוחנן's own words are being used against the rule רב דימי reported in his name. The challenge is that רבי יוחנן seems to contradict himself.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up a direct contradiction within רבי יוחנן. The גמרא will have to resolve whether היתר מצטרף לאיסור is truly limited to נזיר.

phrases.english: And we discussed it:
Why is the place he touched disqualified?
And Rabba bar bar Ḥana said
that Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
What is the reason?
Because a non-priest is lashed for an olive's size of it.
phrases.notes: In a כזית of this soup only a little is תרומה, so the חולין seems to be joining in to make up the amount.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָוֵינַן בַּהּ מְקוֹם מַגָּעוֹ אַמַּאי פָּסוּל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes אביי's objection by quoting רבי יוחנן's own explanation of the משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That permitted food joins with forbidden food even outside of נזיר
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי יוחנן's explanation, through רבה בר בר חנה, that a זר is lashed for a כזית of the mixed soup

steps.title: Asking for the reason behind the lashes
steps.stepSummary: אביי asks why רבי יוחנן holds that a זר is lashed for eating a כזית of the soup, setting up his challenge to רב דימי.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי asks why רבי יוחנן says a זר gets lashes for eating a כזית of the soup. This question is setting up אביי's next move, where the reason will be used against רב דימי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In a כזית of this soup, most of it is חולין and only a little is the תרומה garlic and oil. So אביי is pushing toward the point that the lashes only make sense if the permitted soup joins with the תרומה to make up the כזית. If so, permitted joins with forbidden even outside נזיר, which contradicts what רב דימי reported in רבי יוחנן's name.

keyTerms.meaning: What is his reason? A standard question asking for the logic behind someone's ruling
Permitted food joins with forbidden food to make up the required amount (the idea אביי is driving toward)

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a neutral request for information. אביי already has an answer in mind, and he asks the question to bring out a reason that clashes with רב דימי's report.

phrases.english: What is his reason?
phrases.notes: "His" means רבי יוחנן's. Why does he say a זר is lashed for eating a כזית of the soup?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Follows directly from Step 7. Having cited רבי יוחנן's ruling about lashes for the soup, אביי now asks for its reason in order to build his challenge.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב דימי's report that רבי יוחנן limited the joining of permitted with forbidden to נזיר alone
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The only way to explain lashes for a כזית of soup in which the תרומה garlic and oil are only a small part is that the permitted soup joins with the תרומה. That would show the rule is not limited to נזיר.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason רבי יוחנן holds that a זר is lashed for eating a כזית of the soup touched by a טבול יום.
